run_training_pipeline: run the training pipeline by passing a config YAML path as the first CLI argument
run_main_with_config: run the main function with an OmegaConf DictConfig to start model training on CUDA
load_config_from_yaml: load a training configuration from a YAML file and merge CLI overrides into it
build_optimizer_from_config: build an optimizer from the config optimizer section and the model parameters
load_checkpoint_for_resume: load a checkpoint from a directory to resume training with model and optimizer state
